name: Temeni
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Temeni is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Ashur through his wife Naara. He belongs to the lineage of the tribe of Judah and is part of the genealogical lists that connect the people of Israel to their tribal fathers. Very little is known about Temeni beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Temeni is mentioned as one of the sons of Ashur and Naara in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Ashur
keyEvents.description: Ashur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Hela and Naara. Temeni was among the children of Naara, placing him in an important lineage within Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Through his father Ashur, Temeni is connected to the tribe of Judah, which was the leading tribe in Israel and the tribe from which the royal Davidic line descended.

keyEvents.title: Tekoa's Founding Family
keyEvents.description: Ashhur, the father of Tema, is described as the father of Tekoa, a city later known as the home of the prophet Amos and as an important city in Judah.
